name: ghi-forecast-benchmark-6sites
description: Scripts and aggregate per-site results supporting the manuscript Hourly-ahead global horizontal irradiance forecasting in the humid tropics: satellite cloud dominance and model convergence. The package covers six BMKG climatological stations in Indonesia (Banten, Bengkulu, Jambi, West Kalimantan, Yogyakarta, Central Java; named by province), with harmonised 10-min data from 2022 to 2025 (train 2022–2023, validation 2024, test 2025). It includes data extraction and sanity checks, point and hourly-mean baselines, walk-forward validation, feature ranking (SHAP), source-level ablation with bootstrap significance (Himawari-8/9 cloud optical properties, SYNOP cloud, surface meteorology), a head-to-head of eight machine-learning and deep-learning architectures replicated at all sites, evaluation-protocol sensitivity, probabilistic forecasting (PICP, PINAW, CRPS, PIT), split-conformal calibration with a dedicated calibration set, a test of SYNOP temporal alignment, and the scripts that produce the manuscript figures. No observational data are included: raw and harmonised station data, DuckDB databases, feature tables and trained models are withheld because of size and data-sharing policy. The harmonised BMKG station data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request; Himawari-8/9 cloud products are available through the JAXA P-Tree system.
